name: Expense
label: Expense
description: What an employee paid for the company and asks to be paid back. Above 5,000 it needs a director.
title: what

what.label: What was bought
what.description: A few words a colleague would understand.

cost_centre.label: Cost centre
cost_centre.description: The part of the company that pays for it.

net.label: Net amount
net.description: The amount on the receipt before VAT.

vat_rate.label: VAT rate
vat_rate.description: The rate on the receipt, 23% unless it says otherwise.

vat.label: VAT
vat.description: The VAT on the net amount, to the cent.

total.label: Total
total.description: What the employee is paid back.

needs_director.label: Needs the director
needs_director.description: TRUE above 5,000: then only a director may approve it.

purchase.label: The purchase
purchase.description: What was bought, when, and for whom.

amounts.label: Amounts
amounts.description: What it cost, and what is paid back.

descriptions.draft: Its author writes it and may change it.
descriptions.submitted: Waiting for an approver, who may add to the note. Nothing else changes.
descriptions.approved: Approved, and waiting for accounting to pay it.
descriptions.paid: Paid back. It changes no more.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.label: Submit
transitions.description: The author sends it for approval. It needs a total above zero.

transitions.name: take_back
transitions.label: Take back
transitions.description: The author takes it back to change it, while nobody has approved it.

transitions.name: send_back
transitions.label: Send back
transitions.description: An approver returns it to its author.

transitions.name: approve
transitions.label: Approve
transitions.description: An approver who is not its author accepts it; above 5,000, a director.

transitions.name: pay
transitions.label: Record payment
transitions.description: Accounting records that the employee was paid back.

access.read: CREATEDBY() = USER() OR INGROUP("expense_approvers") OR INGROUP("accountants")
access.update: (CREATEDBY() = USER() AND STATE() = "draft") OR (INGROUP("expense_approvers") AND STATE() = "submitted")

transition.approve: INGROUP("expense_approvers") AND CREATEDBY() <> USER() AND (NOT(needs_director) OR INGROUP("directors"))
